label: Branding
description: Personalizes the server via cvars (qlx_serverBrandName and related) — replaces map-name/other display text with custom branding. Native minqlxtended-plugins version (Thomas Jones).

cvars.label: Brand Name
cvars.description: Custom brand name shown in place of/alongside the server name.

cvars.label: Brand Top Field
cvars.description: Custom text shown in the top branding field.

cvars.label: Brand Bottom Field
cvars.description: Custom text shown in the bottom branding field.

cvars.label: Connect Message
cvars.description: Message shown to a player when they connect.

cvars.label: Loaded Message
cvars.description: Message shown once the player has fully loaded in.

cvars.label: Countdown Message
cvars.description: Message shown during the match countdown.

cvars.label: End Of Game Message
cvars.description: Message shown when the game ends.

cvars.label: Prepend Map Name
cvars.description: Prepends the map name to the branded display text.

cvars.label: Append Game Type
cvars.description: Appends the game type to the branded display text.

cvars.label: Rainbow Brand Name
cvars.description: Cycles the brand name through rainbow colours.
